subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinTechCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinTechCorp

Hi Alice and Bob,

Great to meet with you both this morning — thanks for the time and for walking through your primary use cases (support triage + knowledge base augmentation). Quick recap and a proposed POC plan to keep momentum:

Demo recap
- Scope shown: endpoint-based generation, streaming responses, embeddings index + retrieval pipeline.
- Performance we hit during demo: 95th p50 ~220ms on the sample prompts, average token cost estimates were discussed.

Proposed POC (high level)
1) Sandbox (2 weeks): sandbox environment with a subset of redwood-hosted capacity, example dataset ingestion (sanitized), and an evaluation harness we provide.
2) Evaluation (4 weeks): run production-like queries, measure latency/cost/quality, and iterate prompt/quantization settings.

Success criteria (we should confirm these together)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for your 90% of queries
- Quality: >= 92% pass rate on the QA checklist we attached (intent accuracy + factuality checks)
- Cost: estimated inference cost <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll provide finer numbers after workload profile)
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate during evaluation window

Ownership / responsibilities
- FinTechCorp: Alice (product lead) — owns success criteria sign-off; Bob (engineering) — provides dataset access and test queries.
- Redwood: Marissa (sales lead) — commercial/coordination; Rishi (solutions engineer) — technical setup, evaluation harness, and tuning; Vivek (CS, will be looped) — onboarding & health checks.

Deliverables we will share
- Preconfigured evaluation harness + scripts
- Demo recording and walkthrough (link + attached)
- POC-Evaluation-Checklist.pdf (attached)
- DocuSign link for trial terms (we can do a short trial agreement for the sandbox)

Proposed timeline
- Kickoff week of July 19: environment setup + data ingest
- Sandbox: Jul 19–Jul 30 (2 weeks)
- Evaluation: Aug 2–Aug 27 (4 weeks)
- Sign-off: target week of Aug 30

Next steps (please pick 1–2):
- Confirm kickoff availability (we suggested Jul 19)
- Share a point-of-contact for procurement (if needed for trial terms)
- Confirm any specific compliance checks up front (SOC2 evidence request, if relevant)

Attachments: POC-Evaluation-Checklist.pdf (PDF), redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (video)

Thanks — happy to adjust the timeline and success criteria based on what matters most.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Bob Lee <bob.lee@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Kate Procurement <kate.procurement@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinTechCorp

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A couple of quick clarification items from our side: 

1) Data access: for the sandbox we'll provide a sanitized export of 50k support tickets + KB articles. Does Redwood require a VPN or will S3 share be fine?
2) Volume / scaling: our projected peak is ~120 concurrent users with bursts to 400 qps for short periods. Can you confirm the trial capacity will handle that profile?
3) Cost: curious if you can give a ballpark of incremental cost for the evaluation phase (even a rough monthly estimate) so I can flag to procurement.

Looping in Kate from procurement for the trial terms.

Also — will the evaluation harness support our custom reranking step? We showed a small reranker in the call (we'd like to run it against embeddings).

Thanks,
Bob
Engineering Manager — FinTechCorp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bob Lee <bob.lee@fintechcorp.com>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kate Procurement <kate.procurement@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinTechCorp

Hi Bob / Alice / Kate — thanks for the questions — answers below and a couple of concrete next steps: 

1) Data access: S3 share is perfect for the sandbox. We'll provide an ingestion guide (small script) and Rishi will coordinate credentials. If you prefer VPN we can do that but it takes longer to set up.

2) Capacity: for the trial we will provision a dedicated trial pool sized for your peak profile (including burst capacity to ~500 qps). For the full production rollout we'll right-size based on the evaluation metrics.

3) Cost: rough estimate for the 4-week evaluation given the projected volume is $X–$Y (we'll finalize once we have exact token-level profile). I'm adding a short cost sensitivity note to the checklist.

Reranker support: yes — the evaluation harness can run a custom reranking step. Rishi will work with Bob to integrate the reranker and embeddings flow.

Next concrete steps
- Action 1 (by Fri Jul 16): Bob — share S3 path + sample export (50k tickets) and a set of 200 representative queries.
- Action 2 (by Fri Jul 16): Kate / procurement — confirm whether the short trial agreement is acceptable (DocuSign link below).
- Action 3 (by Tue Jul 20): Redwood (Rishi + Vivek) — environment provisioned and ingestion started.

We created a HubSpot deal and shared folder: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FT-2026-312 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC-Redwood-FinTechCorp.

I've attached the POC-Evaluation-Checklist.pdf with the success criteria and a short cost sensitivity table. DocuSign link for trial terms: https://www.docusign.com/FT-2026-312/trial-terms

Proposed kickoff meeting: Jul 19, 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to review ingestion and success criteria. Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — excited to kick this off.

— Alice
